page.notes: The word after "ita" is printed in italic and reads "anilia" or "aniltra"; I could not settle it, so it is marked [?]. The "'" after "Nicetas," looks like a stray printed mark and is left out. The line "Nicetas,'adeò" has been read as "Nicetas, adeò". No damage or illegible words on this page.
